hints.title: Sorted Greediness
hints.text: Sort both players and trainers in non-decreasing order of abilities.

hints.title: Minimal Capacity Matching
hints.text: For the weakest available player, find the smallest trainer whose capacity is greater than or equal to the player's ability.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Coordination
hints.text: Advance the player pointer only when a valid match is made, and always advance the trainer pointer.

hints.title: Sorted Two-Pointer Matching Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def matchPlayersAndTrainers(self, players: list[int], trainers: list[int]) -> int:
        players.sort()
        trainers.sort()
        p, t = 0, 0
        matches = 0
        while p < len(players) and t < len(trainers):
            if players[p] <= trainers[t]:
                matches += 1
                p += 1
            t += 1
        return matches
```

complexity.time: O(n log n + m log m)
complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(n log n + m log m) followed by single O(n + m) two-pointer pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly searching for available trainers per player causes quadratic complexity O(n * m).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place sort uses O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sorts both arrays and applies greedy two-pointer scanning.
